location: Cliffside Veins, Dwarven Mines,与 Dalir/Brarnas 同在教团聚会场景出现
note: 教团三人组成员,负责提出“门多还是轮子多”这个议题并推动整条模拟论剧情;有一位会打电话来找猫的妻子,是全线的固定笑点。

messages.raw: §fMy wife said we can have a sleepover if you promise not to break anything this time.
messages.text: My wife said we can have a sleepover if you promise not to break anything this time.
messages.zh: 我老婆说了,只要你保证这次别再打碎东西,我们就可以办过夜聚会。

messages.raw: §fYou said you never even saw the plates.
messages.text: You said you never even saw the plates.
messages.zh: 你说过你压根没看见那些盘子。

messages.raw: §fCool.
messages.text: Cool.
messages.zh: 行。

messages.raw: §fI was thinking of hosting it on the fifteenth?
messages.text: I was thinking of hosting it on the fifteenth?
messages.zh: 我本来想定在十五号?

messages.context: 和 Brarnas 的同一句应答。引擎剥掉说话人前缀之后两条一模一样,只能留一条

messages.raw: §fJobs may come and go, but the §5Cult of the Fallen Star§f is eternal.
messages.text: Jobs may come and go, but the Cult of the Fallen Star is eternal.

segments.text: Jobs may come and go, but the

messages.raw: §fAwesome.
messages.text: Awesome.
messages.zh: 太好了。

messages.raw: §fHold up, guys. My wife's calling.
messages.text: Hold up, guys. My wife's calling.
messages.zh: 等一下各位,我老婆打电话来了。

messages.raw: §fHello? Mhm? Okay. Calm down. Yes, I'll come and look, make sure you check under the porch.
messages.text: Hello? Mhm? Okay. Calm down. Yes, I'll come and look, make sure you check under the porch.
messages.zh: 喂?嗯?好。你先别急。好,我这就回去看看,你记得找找门廊底下。

messages.raw: §fCat again. I've got to go.
messages.text: Cat again. I've got to go.
messages.zh: 猫又跑了。我得走了。

messages.raw: §fToday I have something I'd like to talk about.
messages.text: Today I have something I'd like to talk about.
messages.zh: 今天我有件事想说。

messages.raw: §fThe sleepover.
messages.text: The sleepover.
messages.zh: 上次那个过夜聚会。

messages.raw: §fWe're never having another one again.
messages.text: We're never having another one again.
messages.zh: 我们再也不办第二次了。

messages.raw: §fI wonder why. Where do I start?
messages.text: I wonder why. Where do I start?
messages.zh: 你说为什么呢?我该从哪儿说起好?

messages.raw: §fYou didn't take your shows off when you came in.
messages.text: You didn't take your shows off when you came in.
messages.zh: 你进门连鞋都不脱。

messages.raw: §fYou also left the door open, so the cat ran out and I had to spend an hour looking for him.
messages.text: You also left the door open, so the cat ran out and I had to spend an hour looking for him.
messages.zh: 你还把门开着,猫跑出去了,我找了一个小时。

messages.raw: §fAnd, while I was doing that, you ate all of the pizza I ordered for us.
messages.text: And, while I was doing that, you ate all of the pizza I ordered for us.
messages.zh: 我在外面找猫的时候,你把我给大家点的披萨全吃光了。

messages.raw: §fYou then fell asleep in my bed before the show we were meant to watch even began.
messages.text: You then fell asleep in my bed before the show we were meant to watch even began.
messages.zh: 然后我们说好要一起看的剧还没开播,你就在我床上睡着了。

messages.raw: §fYou don't even know which two people died!
messages.text: You don't even know which two people died!
messages.zh: 你连死的是哪两个人都不知道!

messages.raw: §fYou deserved that spoiler. And-
messages.text: You deserved that spoiler. And-
messages.zh: 剧透你活该。还有——

messages.raw: §fApologies.
messages.text: Apologies.
messages.zh: 抱歉。

messages.raw: §fHello? Missing? Again? Okay. Yep, I can hear you. I'll be right there.
messages.text: Hello? Missing? Again? Okay. Yep, I can hear you. I'll be right there.
messages.zh: 喂?又不见了?好。嗯,我听得见。我这就过去。

messages.raw: §fNope, wife.
messages.text: Nope, wife.
messages.zh: 不是,是我老婆。

messages.raw: §fNah, it's fine. She'll be getting a cuppa down in §5Scarleton§f. Thought it was her day off.
messages.text: Nah, it's fine. She'll be getting a cuppa down in Scarleton. Thought it was her day off.

segments.text: Nah, it's fine. She'll be getting a cuppa down in
segments.zh: 没事,不要紧。她八成是跑去

segments.text: . Thought it was her day off.
segments.zh: 喝下午茶了。我还以为她今天休息呢。

messages.raw: §fI should probably go and tell her that she's supposed to be at work.
messages.text: I should probably go and tell her that she's supposed to be at work.
messages.zh: 我最好还是过去告诉她一声,她今天该上班。

messages.raw: §fGuys, today I have something super urgent to discuss.
messages.text: Guys, today I have something super urgent to discuss.
messages.zh: 各位,今天我有件特别紧急的事要讨论。

messages.raw: §fWell... you think there are more doors or wheels in this world?
messages.text: Well... you think there are more doors or wheels in this world?
messages.zh: 那个……你们觉得这世上是门多还是轮子多?

messages.raw: §fI've been thinking about it all week, and I believe there are probably more wheels.
messages.text: I've been thinking about it all week, and I believe there are probably more wheels.
messages.zh: 我想了整整一个星期,我认为应该是轮子更多。

messages.raw: §fWell, first of all, many houses don't even have doors. For example, many of us dwarves don't use them.
messages.text: Well, first of all, many houses don't even have doors. For example, many of us dwarves don't use them.
messages.zh: 首先,很多房子压根就没有门。比如我们矮人里就有不少人不用门。

messages.raw: §fLike, you could just walk right on in to the dwarven palace, if it wasn't for the guards.
messages.text: Like, you could just walk right on in to the dwarven palace, if it wasn't for the guards.
messages.zh: 你看,要不是有卫兵拦着,你完全可以一路直接走进矮人宫殿。

messages.raw: §fYeah. Unless you're like, a philosopher, or something.
messages.text: Yeah. Unless you're like, a philosopher, or something.
messages.zh: 对啊。除非你是那种……哲学家之类的。

messages.raw: §fAnd then, when you think about it, every minecart has four wheels, but no door on it.
messages.text: And then, when you think about it, every minecart has four wheels, but no door on it.
messages.zh: 然后你仔细一想,每辆矿车都有四个轮子,可一扇门都没有。

messages.raw: §fAnd us, being dwarves, have a whole lot of minecarts.
messages.text: And us, being dwarves, have a whole lot of minecarts.
messages.zh: 而我们矮人,矿车多得是。

messages.raw: §fHuh?
messages.text: Huh?
messages.zh: 啊?

messages.raw: §fBut it is a wheel!
messages.text: But it is a wheel!
messages.zh: 可它就是轮子啊!

messages.raw: §fBecause everyone calls it a wheel!
messages.text: Because everyone calls it a wheel!
messages.zh: 因为大家都管它叫轮子啊!

messages.raw: §fNow that I think about it, no. I've never seen a minecart actually move. They're always in the same place!
messages.text: Now that I think about it, no. I've never seen a minecart actually move. They're always in the same place!
messages.zh: 现在这么一想,还真没有。我从没见过矿车真的动起来。它们永远都停在原地!

messages.raw: §fThen what are they there for? Just for decoration?
messages.text: Then what are they there for? Just for decoration?
messages.zh: 那它们摆在那儿是干嘛的?纯粹当摆设?

messages.raw: §fGuys... are we living in a simulation?
messages.text: Guys... are we living in a simulation?
messages.zh: 各位……我们是不是活在一个模拟里?

messages.raw: §fYup!
messages.text: Yup!
messages.zh: 没错。

messages.raw: §dBednom§f always has a §dnightmare§f.
messages.text: Bednom always has a nightmare.

messages.raw: §6Brynmor§f always loses his §cSpeckled Teacup§f.
messages.text: Brynmor always loses his Speckled Teacup.

messages.raw: §eFetchur§f always needs someone to bring him something.
messages.text: Fetchur always needs someone to bring him something.

segments.text: always needs someone to bring him something.
segments.zh: 永远都要人帮他带东西。

messages.raw: §fAnd, when we asked them about it, none of them knew why they do what they do!
messages.text: And, when we asked them about it, none of them knew why they do what they do!
messages.zh: 而我们问起他们的时候,没有一个人说得出自己为什么要这么做!

messages.raw: §fWhat is it?
messages.text: What is it?
messages.zh: 怎么了?

messages.raw: §fTo think I was right all along.
messages.text: To think I was right all along.
messages.zh: 没想到我一直都是对的。

messages.raw: §fI can't believe it...
messages.text: I can't believe it...
messages.zh: 我简直不敢相信……

messages.raw: §fWe really are living in a §kX§rsimulation§kX§r!
messages.text: We really are living in a XsimulationX!

segments.text: We really are living in a

messages.raw: §fPlease don't leave, §b%s§f, I don't want to die!
messages.text: Please don't leave, %s, I don't want to die!

messages.raw: §fHow about we order a pizza?
messages.text: How about we order a pizza?
messages.zh: 要不我们点份披萨吧?

messages.raw: §fOoh, a §9blue pizza§f! That's my favorite!
messages.text: Ooh, a blue pizza! That's my favorite!

messages.raw: §fHopefully it'll all be over when we wake up tomorrow...
messages.text: Hopefully it'll all be over when we wake up tomorrow...
messages.zh: 但愿明天一觉醒来,这一切都过去了……
